header: What a second reader said about the numbers of a circular's pages, for the answer card (the gate in circularAnswer.ts).

The cross-check script (scripts/crosscheck-report.ts --apply) stores, per page, the numbers both readings had ("confirmed") and the numbers only the pipeline had ("unconfirmed"), together with a FINGERPRINT of the page text it checked. I use a check only while the stored page text still has that fingerprint: if the circular is re-read later, its check is stale and is ignored, so a check can never vouch for text it did not see.
